name: Yume Shokushu!
source:
A package was sent to me one day, a panties was in. With the "dream" panties on in bed, anyone can have a dream whatever it is. A glasses girl tries to see the effect, but...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE013042.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，我收到了一個包裹，裡面有一條內褲。只要穿上「夢想」內褲躺在床上，誰都能做自己想做的夢，夢見什麼都行。一位戴眼鏡的女孩試圖看看效果，但是……
